# RepViT attribution

The RepViT backbone in `src/models/backbones/repvit.py` is based on [THU-MIG/RepViT](https://github.com/THU-MIG/RepViT). The upstream source reference is `298f42075eda5d2e6102559fad260c970769d34e`.

The upstream Apache License 2.0 is retained in [LICENSE](LICENSE). This repository includes the backbone components used by CADLGI-Rep.
